answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 60681 Country: India Title: Charity for deceased parents by daughter Question: 1. My mother wants to do charity and qurbani in the name of her deceased parents by using the money given by my father or me (son). Is it allowed? 2. My mother has problem of coughing frequently, while praying if she gets cough drop of urine is dripped. This happens frequently. Showed to many doctors, they said can't do much about it, it allergic cough, no permanent cure. Can she continue her prayers or she need to clean and then pray? Again this happens very frequently. Answer ID: 60681 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1036/1032/B=11/1436) (1) Yes, your parents may offer nafl qurbani in their parents’ name by this money as well as give it in charity. (2) If she coughs so much that she cannot offer salah of one time by making wudhu in the state of taharah then she is mazur. She should make wudhu for the time of each salah and offer salah in the same condition. Her salah shall be valid though the drops of urine keep on coming. If it is not so then she will have to offer salah again in case of urine drops. You should get her treated by any expert Unani physician, her coughing problem shall go away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
